STATE_VOCABULARY.PASS: Evidence was executed and is current under RULE_OBSERVATION_FRESHNESS.
STATE_VOCABULARY.PASS_OVER_STALE_INPUT: The gate mechanism passes, but the observation it derives from is stale. Not creditable for a stage transition.
STATE_VOCABULARY.PARTIAL: The gate exists and runs, but its pass criteria are not fully met or not fully non-vacuous.
STATE_VOCABULARY.PREPARED: A package or criterion exists with zero execution. Preparation is NOT readiness.
STATE_VOCABULARY.STALE: Evidence exists but predates the current state of the thing it describes.
STATE_VOCABULARY.UNKNOWN: Not measurable from the repository; requires an operator observation.
STATE_VOCABULARY.UNSATISFIABLE: The criterion as written cannot be met by any execution, so it must be retired or restated rather than attempted.
STATE_VOCABULARY.OPEN: An adjudication or decision is outstanding.

NON_REGRESSION_RULE: A gate is listed once, at the EARLIEST stage that requires it, in first_required_at_stage. A gate required at stage N remains required at every later stage; a later stage inherits all earlier gates and may not be declared while an inherited gate has regressed. Per-stage gate sets are therefore DERIVED from this field and are never restated, so the two artifacts in this pair cannot drift apart.
EVIDENCE_IDENTITY_RULE: Every gate's evidence must name the exact SHA it was produced against, plus the exact target identifier where a hosted target is involved. Evidence that cannot name its SHA is not evidence for any stage transition.

GATES.hpo_g_binding: release CI reconciles actually collected and executed files
why_an_exit_code_is_insufficient: A worker process that dies produces a non-zero exit with NO reporter row, so the lost file is invisible in the report even though the run is red.
A file skipped for an environmental reason produces neither a failure nor a row, so it is invisible in a green run.
Therefore set reconciliation, not the exit code, is what makes this gate non-vacuous.

DUPLICATE_GATE_RESOLUTION.rule: Each entry names the legacy gates that were competing for the same decision, the canonical ID that now carries it, and the DISPOSITION of each legacy gate. A release decision cites the canonical ID. Disposition CANONICALIZED_INTO means the legacy document remains readable as history but is no longer the thing a release cites; RETIRED_AS_UNSATISFIABLE means the criterion as written cannot be met by any execution and must not be attempted; AWAITING_ADJUDICATION means this artifact does NOT resolve it and has no authority to.

resolutions.contested_decision: which machine gates are mandatory before a change is considered done
legacy_sources: the release workstream document list of mandatory local gates
the CI workflow step list
the poststate composed step list
the test manifest schema exit-gate enumeration
an exit gate named for full CI greenness that the schema never defines
the beta release baseline list
disagreements: the release document requires offline evaluations that the CI workflow does not run
the CI workflow runs a secret scan, seal verification, derived-artifact verifications and a build that the release document does not list
the manifest schema enumeration omits lint, build, browser end-to-end and full CI greenness
four test manifests declare an exit gate that is outside the schema enumeration, so the declaration cannot be validated
dependency audit and schema drift appear only in the beta baseline
resolutions.required_follow_on: The manifest schema must gain the missing exit-gate names in a successor version so that a manifest can declare them validly. That is an implementation change and is NOT performed by this lane.

resolutions.contested_decision: how tenant isolation is verified against a hosted target
legacy_sources: the human gate requiring the integration row-level-security suite to be green against staging
the legacy validation workflow
a line in the pilot gate document asserting isolation is verified in staging
an enumerated production-state unknown about live isolation posture
disagreements: the integration test setup pins a loopback connection, so the suite cannot address a hosted target at all
the legacy validation workflow is self-documented as unable to pass
resolutions.retirement_reason: The criterion as written is not merely unmet, it is unmeetable: the harness pins a loopback connection. Leaving it open invites someone to satisfy it by repointing the harness at a hosted database, which would run a mutating test suite against a live target. Retiring it is a SAFETY action, not a relaxation.
resolutions.canonical_replacement: Real-PostgreSQL isolation gates in CI, plus a READ-ONLY closed-world census of the hosted catalog. Never a mutating suite against a hosted target.

legacy_sources: the human smoke gate

resolutions.separation_of_roles: M9 with J1 to J3 is the AUTOMATED proof. G8 is the HUMAN ACCEPTANCE act. G13 is the provider-dark staging run. J4 is the governed-assistant journey against real PostgreSQL. These four are complementary, and no one of them substitutes for another.

OPEN_FINDINGS.finding: The health contract conflict for an anonymous caller is unadjudicated. Automating a smoke gate before adjudication would freeze an arbitrary contract.
No successor ACL package exists for the tables added after the last hosted ACL package, so a schema-only apply produces a deployment where the runtime role is denied on those tables.

The only resumable applier pins a single expected branch name measured from the LOCAL branch, so the authority that opens a staging apply must also resolve that pin. Advancing that branch by pushing it would deploy new code against the old database, which is the inverse of the required order.
The legacy isolation gate is unsatisfiable as written, and the obvious way to make it pass would point a mutating suite at a live database.
The real-provider stage is blocked by an organizational governance decision that the evaluation gate package does not mention.
The destroy-and-reprovision doctrine is calibrated for an empty target and is not a recovery path for a target holding data.
An authority merging is not a capability existing. The email-verification Packet B authority merged at AS_OF_HEAD with no enforcement code, and must not be credited as provider readiness.
Four committed test manifests declare an exit gate that the manifest schema does not define, so that declaration cannot be validated today.
Whether the offline release-candidate criteria still hold at AS_OF_HEAD is UNKNOWN. This lane executed no tests, and an older recorded pass is not a current pass.
Branch protection is not observable from the repository and was measured absent by an earlier lane. Until observed, a green CI run is not proof that a merge was gated.
